understory.densityRule: Existing LiDAR/aerial canopy candidates with at least three additional tree candidates within 22 m; deterministic 22% subset. Each patch is centered on an existing canopy point, so road/building clearance is retained. Small, low-alpha leaf-litter and shrub sprites follow sampled DEM ground and add no collision.

treeCoordinateOrder: Each tile treeRadiusDm entry aligns by index with public/data/tiles/<tile>.json trees; existing x,z coordinates are unchanged.

water.rendering: Each OSM water polygon is triangulated with holes preserved and subdivided to at most 10 m edges. A per-vertex shore-distance field feeds a smooth fragment color/alpha transition; subtle two-direction world-space wind ripples deform normals and fade with camera distance (72–148 m). Water level follows the low 5th percentile of DEM shoreline samples, capped to 0.22 m above the lowest sample.

method: At each existing tree coordinate, sample 8 radial LiDAR canopy-height profiles at 2 m intervals; estimate the outer crown at 42% of local peak height, median the eight directions, and cap merged crowns at 42% of nearest-tree spacing (maximum radius 7.5 m). Quantize radius to 0.1 m.
